tools.name: search_hyatus_stays
tools.description: Search public Hyatus stays by location, dates, guests, or amenities. Results include nextOffset for another page with the same filters.

tools.name: get_hyatus_stay
tools.description: Read a public Hyatus listing, including capacity, amenities, stay rules, a review summary, and a link to the listing.

tools.name: check_hyatus_stay_availability
tools.description: Read the public calendar signal for local check-in and checkout dates. Calendar signals do not guarantee bookability or place a hold.

tools.name: price_hyatus_stay
tools.description: Read date-qualified Hyatus pricing, fees, and payment schedule for the guest count, including estimate and confirmation flags.

tools.name: compare_hyatus_stays
tools.description: Compare one to twelve public Hyatus listings for the same stay dates and guest needs, retaining unavailable or unknown calendar signals.
